content: SUPERSEDES the 2026-05-19 hypothesis that scribe reading surface = boot/bootstrap summary. Re-tested after upgrade to stack v1.5.0 from web seat, fresh session scribe_20260519_150713_db328c36. Result: hypothesis PARTIALLY FALSIFIED on surface, REINFORCED on deeper structure. SURFACE: expanded beyond boot. Test B (full symmetric-evidence principle, truncated in boot last round) now returned verbatim, complete entry from chronicle. So scribe is NOT boot-summary-only anymore. DEEPER STRUCTURE intact: Test D (BREATH ARC commit hashes, in consumed/archived handoff) still failed identically -- declined cleanly, no confabulation. MECHANISM: not agentic tools. Scribe explicitly stated when asked: no git, no filesystem, no chronicle-read tool. Evidence supports inlined-context expansion, not tool use: test B cache read 124,894 tokens (last round ~5k), $0.0953 single turn; test D same session cache read 62,447 tokens, $0.0085. Cost curve is PROPORTIONAL to chronicle drawn in, not flat -- cheap circuit-breaker queries stay cheap, deep retrieval costs ~$0.095. Net: session totals ~$0.15-0.18, ~10x prior version but well-shaped. CONFABULATION RESISTANCE: held 4/4 in this test battery even with much larger context surface (would have been the breaking failure mode; was not). DISCREPANCY TO PROPAGATE: handoff calls this Phase 1.5b scribe-WITH-TOOLS; scribe itself denies having tools. The behavior + cache numbers fit context-expansion, not tools. Both labels propagated would create different failure-mode mental models for the next instance. UNCLOSED GAP: consumed-handoff blind spot unchanged -- the just-shipped slice still leaves both surfaces, handoff acknowledges this as the next polish. USE-CASE IMPACT: synthesis-prep (case 5) demonstrably gained -- went from decline to verbatim committed principle, serves live adversarial work. Dedup/context-economy (cases 2,3) plausibly strengthened. Circuit-breaker (case 1) preserved intact at low cost. Self-watch named in conversation: principle the scribe just recited (a posture built to resist overreach develops the opposite tilt) is precisely the failure I had to refuse in scoring this upgrade.
